newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian couple said to sell twins for a song.
newsitem.headline: Colombian couple said to sell twins for a song.

text.p: A Colombian couple with 18 children sold the latest addition to their family, a pair of six-month-old twins, for $300 and a small plot of land, Bogota's El Espectador newspaper said on Friday.

It said the couple, a 31-year-old man and his wife, 37, had been jailed in their impoverished home town of San Pedro, in southwest Valle province, after neighbours denounced the sale of the twin girls.
The buyers of the girls have not been identified but they were believed to be linked to an international child smuggling ring, El Espectador said.
